summary.motive: Exploit second-level defenders overplaying the run by throwing deep intermediate passes into the vacated zone behind them.
summary.whyItWorks: Because outside zone forces the Mike to sprint laterally and downhill to protect the edge, play-action easily draws him out of intermediate pass coverage windows.
summary.failureMode: Pass rush pressure beating the line before the deep crossing route has time to clear the linebackers at 16+ yards.

beats.title: 1. Identical Run-Action Picture
beats.text: The entire offensive line and running back mirror Outside Zone Left with 100% fidelity. For the first second, the defense sees only base run flow.

beats.title: 2. The Linebacker Run Bite
beats.text: Having been conditioned by wide zone, the Mike and Will linebackers trigger downhill into the A/B gaps to stop the run, completely abandoning intermediate zone depth.

beats.title: 3. The Intermediate Honey Hole Opens
beats.text: The QB pulls the ball at mesh. The X post route occupies the free safety deep, creating a 20-yard vacant void between the biting linebackers and the retreating deep third.

beats.title: 4. Deep Strike Across the Formation
beats.text: Z crosses cleanly behind the compromised linebackers, catching the ball in full stride with zero defenders within 10 yards.

relations.tell: Backside WR (Z) cuts across the formation behind linebackers on a deep Over route instead of stalking downfield.
